prompt:
TASK: Edit image 1. This is a local revision of the supplied artwork.
INPUT IMAGES (in supplied order):
Image 1: edit-target. Base image to edit; requested changes take precedence over preservation.
CHANGE REQUEST:
Make this the same warm evening office as the previous panels: re-light the whole scene with soft warm sunset light (golden-orange tones on the walls, the figures and the desk), and change the window at the top centre so it shows an orange-pink evening sky with dark tree silhouettes and a rolled-up beige roller blind at its top, matching the neighbouring evening panels; replace the blue curtain with that roller blind. The doorway at the right may stay but should be dimmer, lit by warm indoor light. Keep Dr. Ananya and Meera exactly as they are (faces, expressions, poses, Ananya's raised fist and hand on the desk, Meera's staff phone in her right hand with the bangle), the laptop with its blank abstract screen, the bookshelf, the plant and the framed leaf print. No text.
PRESERVE: retain all areas, identity traits, acting, clothing, composition and lettering space outside the requested change. The change request overrides preservation where necessary; repair connected anatomy, contact objects and occlusion together. Supporting images supply only their stated roles. Do not copy their entire scene or pose.
OUTPUT: one edited image matching the target aspect. Do not add text, guide marks or a global style filter. Re-measure faces and mouths and inspect lettering space after adoption.
